Editing videos is one creative and technical decision after another. Editors have to shape the story, place sound effects, build transitions, adjust color, and more. Invideo(opens in a new window) is an agentic video editor designed to handle that work while keeping the human editor in control. GPT‑6 Astra is especially effective when it comes to color work, where the agent must choose from overlapping approaches such as correction, grading, regeneration, LUTs, and isolation.
